meta.name: self-improvement-loop
meta.description: Run a controlled self-improvement event loop for agents, skills, prompts, routing, tools, memory, and evaluation packs. Use during an active task or between tasks when the agent fails validation, receives corrective user feedback, chooses the wrong skill, misuses tools, wastes context, misses tests, repeats a weak behavior, or needs a measured repair based on logs, evals, user feedback, Obsidian memory, and regression checks.

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手根据反馈自我修正，越用越准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望 AI 能根据反馈自动调整行为，不断改进。
copy.tagline_en: Make AI self-correct from mistakes and feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to learn from feedback and improve autonomously.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 遇到失败或纠正时,会启动自我改进循环:分析根因,对技能、路由、提示、工具或记忆做最小改动,用回归测试验证,记入记忆,再回到原任务。它不会擅自扩大权限,同类失败最多试两次就上报。
howto.when: 在任务进行中或间隙,当 Claude 验证失败、被用户纠正,或反复出现同样的弱行为时触发。

say.text: 刚才你答错了,请开启自我改进循环,分析根因并修复。
say.note: Claude 会按流程分析并做出最小改动。

say.text: 你连续两次选错技能了,启动改进循环,并为该类失败加回归测试。
say.note: 它会记录学习并防止再犯。

say.text: 根据这次反馈做一次受控改进,保留证据后回到原任务。
say.note: 改进会被验证,然后继续原任务。

howto.what_en: On failure, Claude runs a bounded self-improvement loop: analyze, patch skills/routing/tools/memory minimally, validate with regression checks, record learning, resume. No autonomy increase; escalate after two attempts.
howto.when_en: Triggered during an active task or between tasks when Claude fails validation, receives corrective user feedback, or repeats a weak behavior.

say_en.text: You got that wrong; run the loop to find the root cause and fix it.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and make a minimal change.

say_en.text: Wrong skill again; run the loop and add a regression test for this failure.
say_en.note: It will record the lesson and prevent recurrence.

say_en.text: Run a bounded improvement from this feedback, keep evidence, then resume.
say_en.note: Improvement is validated, then the task continues.
